text:
maria (marketing): Heads up — ops flagged a sustained degradation in embeddings for hosted API. Need customer-facing comms: status page copy, timing for emails/registrants, and inbound lead routing if we pause webinars.

aj (ops): Incident opened, severity P2. Affected: embeddings for models > 2k tokens in eu-west and us-west. ETA for mitigation unknown right now.

deploy-bot: Incident 1965012345 created by aj — tags: embeddings, region-eu, region-us, degradation.

maria (marketing): OK. Two immediate asks: (1) short statuspage copy we can publish now, (2) guidance on whether to postpone this week's benchmarking webinar & what to tell registrants. Also need a routing rule for inbound leads from webinar landing page.

tom (support): Draft status snippets — short (single-line) + expanded (for incident page). Pick one and we can push.

-- Short option --
```
We're investigating degraded embeddings performance in eu-west and us-west. Some requests may time out or be slower than usual. We'll update here as we have more info.
```

-- Expanded option --
```
We are currently investigating an issue impacting embeddings for larger context lengths in eu-west and us-west. Customers may see increased latency or failed requests for affected models. Our engineers are working on mitigation; no customer data loss is expected. We will post updates every 30 minutes and notify customers directly if they are on Dedicated/Private plans.
```

emily (product): I like the expanded copy but shorten the last sentence about updates to "updates every 30m". Also add callout: "If you rely on real-time embeddings, consider switching to smaller context models as a temporary workaround."

maria (marketing): Good. We'll publish expanded with Emily's tweak. Who owns the webhook to the status page? aj?

aj (ops): I can publish. Will also add the 30m cadence.

maria (marketing): Webinar: we have 220 registrants for "Benchmarking at Scale" scheduled Thu 10am PT. Recommendation: pause registration & add banner "Live event proceeding as planned but new content will not include live demos of embeddings; recorded demos will be available. Registrants notified." Thoughts? :thinking_face:

nate (eng): If demos rely on embeddings, they may fail during the session. I'd recommend we either replace live demos with pre-recorded runs (fastest) or move the session by 1 week. Pre-recorded reduces churn and avoids rescheduling email.

emily (product): Pre-recorded + short live Q&A is my vote. We should send an email to registrants with a clear line: what changed, why, and next steps (link to postponed demo recording + follow-up Q&A date). Keep tone factual and calm.

maria (marketing): Agreed. Draft email copy (short):
```
Subject: Update on "Benchmarking at Scale" — live demos changing
Hi —
Due to a temporary degradation affecting embeddings in some regions, our live demos will be replaced by a pre-recorded walkthrough. The event will still be on Thu 10am PT for a shorter live Q&A. A recording of the full demos will be available after the session.
We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
Link to join: <webinar-link>
```

maria (marketing): Routing rules for inbound leads from the registration page:
- If account tier == Enterprise or Dedicated tag present -> route to Enterprise SDR queue (priority).
- If account flagged via single-signup email domain in allowlist -> route to Solutions AE.
- Otherwise -> Marketing SDR nurture with "incident affected?" flag.

tom (support): Also add a follow-up task: when incident resolved, send "we're back" email + attach the recording and a short note on what changed. That email should include an unobtrusive opt-in for a dedicated postmortem webinar for customers who want more detail.

maria (marketing): Good call. I'll draft the post-incident email template.

aj (ops): Ops will add enterprise-level direct notifications (email + slack DM to account contacts) for Dedicated customers within 15m of resolution.

maria (marketing): Final checklist before publish: 1) Ops to post statuspage (aj) — now. 2) Marketing to update webinar page & pause registration (maria) — now. 3) Registrant email sent (maria) — within 30m. 4) Lead routing rules added to CRM (sales ops) — within 60m. 5) Post-incident follow-up template (maria) — draft ready by next update.

nate (eng): We'll post a technical follow-up (short blurb) after rollback/mitigation summarizing root cause and workaround.

maria (marketing): Thanks everyone. I'll post the first status update once AJ confirms publish. :thumbsup:
